new.brief: Creates an accessible object that represents a hyperlink.
new.md:
Creates an accessible object that represents a hyperlink.

This is meant to be used with an implementation of the
[`AccessibleHypertext`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleHypertext) interface.

doc.md:
Represents a link (i.e. a uri).

A widget that contains one or more links should implement
the [`AccessibleHypertext`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleHypertext) interface and return
`GtkAccessibleHyperlink` objects for each of the links.

set_platform_state.brief: Sets a platform state on the accessible.
set_platform_state.md: Sets a platform state on the accessible.
